patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: My cheek got red and swollen yesterday, and now it's spreading toward my eye. It's hot and tender, my eye is puffy, and I've got a fever.
clinical.presentationShort: 43yo F ? 1 day spreading redness, heat, tenderness and swelling of cheek toward eye; eyelid puffy, febrile, eye movement and vision not yet assessed.
clinical.presentationLong: 43-year-old female with one day of rapidly spreading redness, warmth, tenderness, and swelling from her cheek toward the eye. Her eyelid is puffy and temperature is 38.3?C; visual acuity and pain with eye movement have not yet been assessed.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → antibiotics, mark the border, CT and ophtho if any orbital signs (pain with eye movement, proptosis, vision change); monitor.
diagnosis.why: Facial cellulitis near the eye: check eye movement and vision. Preseptal is treatable; orbital cellulitis is an emergency.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Create a new square isolated patient character asset for patient 100, closely matching the attached references' softly shaded painterly semi-realistic animated clinical-illustration style, warm natural rendering, fine outlines, adult Hispanic woman's appearance, and blue padded clinic chair. IMPORTANT BACKGROUND REQUIREMENT: place the isolated patient and chair against a perfectly uniform, solid pure chroma-key green background (#00FF00), edge to edge. No gradient, texture, scenery, vignette, floor, cast shadow, green spill, or green clothing. The green will be removed to transparency later. Show exactly one Hispanic 43-year-old woman in a coral or burgundy casual top, dark pants, and neutral shoes, seated in a full-body three-quarter front view with the entire head, body, both arms and hands, legs, shoes, and whole chair inside frame. Her expression is uncomfortable and worried, but she is alert and stable. One hand hovers near—not covering—the affected cheek. Make the clinical sign clearly visible: unilateral warm red swelling begins over one cheek and visibly extends upward along that same side of the face toward the lower eyelid. The lower eyelid on that side is mildly puffy and slightly narrowed, while the eye remains open without proptosis. The erythema should have a natural irregular soft-edged spread, not symmetrical makeup or a circular blush. The other cheek and other eyelid remain normal. No wound, dental instrument, rash elsewhere, severe eye bulging, bruising, blood, or gore. Natural anatomy: exactly two arms, two hands, two legs, and two feet. No medical equipment, text, labels, or logos.
